items.title: /v/ Video Games: Play SpaceChem. Most of Zachtronics' games are great but this one is my favourit…
items.content_text: Play SpaceChem. Most of Zachtronics' games are great but this one is my favourite. It's chemistry autism, a lot of puzzle games are very constrained and just want you to fiddle forever to find a solution. This one gives you the rules, the requirements and tells you to find a solution yourself with the tools available, and it's really fun trying to optimise them. Story and soundtrack is pretty nice too.
